items.quote: He sought God during the days of Zechariah, who instructed him in the fear of God.
items.contrast: Uzziah, the subject referred to by “He” and “him,” versus his father Amaziah.
items.reason: The passage continues describing Uzziah, so “him” refers to Uzziah. Identifying the student requires resolving the pronoun rather than confusing him with the previously mentioned Amaziah.
